limits: Exact-date ruler/household claims remain uncertain in all five cases.
No named active spouse, child, heir, birth date or generated person.
No accepted state polygon; no point containment, overlap or gameplay validation performed.
Demographic decline, last dated inscription, dynastic failure and abandonment are distinct.

independentReview.scope: Forty individual claims; confirmation of an attribution does not remove source uncertainty or approve an active court.

followup.scope: Two exact revised document claims and their chronology/value fields.

sourceMetadataQualification.followupFinding: The individual Getty place page does not state ODC-By; this metadata assertion was unsupported within the follow-up subset.
sourceMetadataQualification.resolution: The initial separately confirmed d2-800-point-rights claim cites Getty licensing and ODC-By directly. All five point-source records now explicitly link those existing sources. The follow-up did not recheck those separate pages.

independentReview.rulerEvidenceRule: A sufficiently supported reign interval containing the bookmark can establish a ruler under the research brief. This dossier keeps the submitted candidate assessments uncertain; it introduces no universal requirement for an act on the exact day, and its source checks do not create active court seeds.
